subject.title: fix(chat): keep proof decision out of actor closure

question: Should this PR's explicit proof lock be accepted as the synchronization boundary for queued chat cancellation and canonical proof observation?
rationale: The patch appears correct and focused, but it changes the lifetime of a lock that decides whether a canceled queued message is confirmed as delivered or removed locally, so owner intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
options.body: Merge after the assigned owner confirms the manual lock/defer shape intentionally covers proof decision, SQLite commit, cache cleanup, and cancellation notification ordering.

options.title: Tighten Lock Scope First
options.body: Ask for a narrower local scope that releases the proof lock after proof decision, SQLite commit, and cache removal while still avoiding actor-isolated closure capture.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after the assigned owner confirms the manual lock/defer shape intentionally covers proof decision, SQLite commit, cache cleanup, and cancellation notification ordering.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` is the live assignee for this PR and is the clearest current review route for the message-delivery synchronization choice.
